Instrument Perception

Grace Brown

2026-02-03

Load Data

## english
df.en <- read_csv("./data/english/perception-expanded.csv",
               show_col_types = FALSE) 
stim.key.en <- read_csv("./data/english/perception-stim-key.csv",
                     show_col_types = FALSE)

## italian
df.it <- read_csv("./data/italian/perception-expanded.csv",
               show_col_types = FALSE) 
stim.key.it <- read_csv("./data/italian/perception-stim-key.csv",
                     show_col_types = FALSE)

## combine data
df <- rbind(df.en, df.it) 
df$study_id <- factor(df$study_id,
                      levels = c("6980c7c83940647eb7aa7467", "6980d28a9ba9868bcbb63d77"),
                      labels = c("English", "Italian"))
